page.layout: One page of text in one column. Running head at top with page number at top right. Below the running head: a verse stanza in italic, the subscription "N. C. A. D." at right, a rule, then a heading with subtitle, then a verse passage opening with a large initial. Gathering signature at the foot right.

l.i: Quas nullo meruere pati pro crimine poenas.
Nil (inquam) nihil ista moror. Sedet æthere rector
Omnipotens, templóque habitat sanctissimus
alto. Ille videt terras, illi mortalia curæ,
Ille tegit iustos, & amat peccare timentes,
Terribilisque odijs & sævo numine vindex
Bella monet metuenda malis, atque aggerat iras.
In genus hoc pluet igne, pluet candente familla,
Flammeus attonitis supra caput irruet imber,
Ardentésque faces & olentes sulphura tædæ.
Tum cinis, & rapida dirus vertigine turbo
Hauriet, & cumulis ambustos obruet altis.
Hic finis vitæ miseris, hic exitus illos
Sorte ferét. Sed enim iustos pia cura fanórque
Numinis & custos aduersis dextera rebus
Seruabit, placidáque suos in pace locabit.
VENERE Gentes, ô Deus, in tuam
Hereditatem, templáque quæ tuæ
Stabant sacrata sanctitati
(Triste nefas!) male polluerunt.

page.notes: The first stanza's line 2 reads "Nil (inquam) nihil ista moror." with "rector" set with a ct ligature; transcribed as rector. "familla" and "fanórque" are copied as printed. The subscription "N. C. A. D." is set right-aligned and treated as a paragraph. The large initial V of "VENERE" is joined to the word. The gathering signature "Q. iij." is at the lower right. Some faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the right half and was left out.
